The FloPlast 90° half round angle in black is a vital uPVC gutter fitting, designed to connect and change the direction of 112mm half round rainwater systems. This durable black gutter angle is suitable for various applications, including new build construction and property refurbishment projects, ensuring efficient water management around building corners. Manufactured from high-quality uPVC, it provides a practical and easy to install solution for trade professionals. The angle features double socket ends, and is compatible with most major guttering manufacturers, offering a seamless and reliable drainage connection.
